source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For viewing the ebook, could we make read-only the default, with a large button on the email certificate labeled "Read 'My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal' Now" and an optional smaller link labeled "Download PDF for Offline Reading"?
Add a PDF.js viewer to the dashboard/email link.

cool?

We also need to add that FAQ.

There should be a new section explaining how non-crypto fiat buyers receive commissions and prizes. This is crucial for normies: a non-custodial wallet is created for them behind the scenes with no seed phrase, but they may not understand how to access their rewards.
Maybe something along these lines:

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're paying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and are new to crypto, there's no need to worry—the process is built to be straightforward. When you mint the book for $15 through Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically set up for you in the background, with no seed phrase required. That wallet stores your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

The process works as follows:
During the Purchase:
Transak converts the fiat to crypto and mints the NFT directly to a newly created wallet address for you.
There is nothing you need to configure manually—the experience is seamless and non-custodial (you control the keys, without having to manage a complicated seed phrase right away).
Your confirmation email will contain your mint number (which is your referral code), the NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on [URL_002].

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Give people your referral code (for example, "use 8421"). Whenever someone uses it to mint, $5 is sent automatically to your wallet address.
To collect: Sign in to your dashboard on [URL_002], either through the email link or via SIWE with the wallet created by Transak. Your commissions show there instantly, with no action required. If necessary, we'll guide you through exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Every referral awards you tickets for the active prize draws, automatically linked to your NFT/wallet.
The draws occur on-chain using fair randomness—every ~100 sales for $500 and every ~10,000 sales for $10,000.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and are also notified by email.

To collect a prize: If you win, the $500 or $10,000 amount is sent directly to your wallet.
Look for notifications in your dashboard/email.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. Big Block: 5 × $10,000 awarded every 50,000 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize winners are announced on the Winners page, notified through dashboard and email, and receive the prize directly in their wallet.

decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the one-click-claim FAQ copy with direct wallet delivery and therefore fully represents the impact.
Automatic prize delivery does not change the existing Winners page, dashboard, or email notification requirements, which are already represented at message 184.
Changing prize collection to automatic wallet delivery does not alter Big Block winner counts, prize amounts, draw triggers, funding, or ticket-cycle rules.
Changing prize collection to automatic wallet delivery does not alter Small Block winner counts, prize amounts, draw timing, funding, or ticket-cycle rules.
The referral commission was already an immediate automatic wallet payout; the prize-delivery change does not modify its amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or destination.
Automatic transfer of awarded prizes does not resolve or modify the separate uncertainty about whether Aave should continue providing prize-pool yield.
Prize delivery after selection is independent of the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method, eligible population, ticket weighting, and verification behavior.
Automatic prize delivery does not change how tickets from mints without referral codes are allocated to existing NFT holders.
The prize-delivery mode does not change the trigger, recipient, quantity, lifecycle, or sale-type eligibility of referral prize tickets.
Direct wallet delivery of a prize does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets transfer during resale.
Automatic prize delivery does not change the separate Small and Big Block ticket counters or their post-draw reset behavior.
